svg.title: Cross-Team Knowledge Relay High-Level Design Architecture
svg.desc: Architecture diagram for Cross-Team Knowledge Relay.
svg.text: End-to-end system view: clients, API edge, Go services, data stores, async matching, notifications, and operations.
• User submits bounty → API validates → BountyCreated event → worker runs Neo4j matching → Redis Pub/Sub → realtime client shows ranked cross-team experts →
